items.title: Eight killed and others missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
items.description: A search and rescue operation is under way after a ferry carrying nearly 270 people turns over after leaving port.

items.title: US strikes Iranian launchers on Larak Island in first known attack in weeks
items.description: Iran says the attack killed some civilians and is the first known US strike on Iran since late July.

items.title: Iceland votes against restarting EU membership talks
items.description: Broadcaster RUV reports that 52.8% of voters rejected the government's proposal to resume accession talks.

items.title: Manhunt after shooting at Swiss rave kills woman, 22, and injures five
items.description: Five others in their twenties were injured after shots were fired at a techno event near Zurich.

items.title: Hikers feared missing after 'terrifying' flash flooding hits Grand Canyon
items.description: "It was a beautiful day - and then people were screaming," one hiker who was airlifted to safety tells the BBC.

items.title: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
items.description: The US space agency's telescope is starting a multi-year mission to create a new map of the universe and learn more about dark energy and dark matter.

items.title: Zambian opposition leader charged with treason
items.description: Mundubile had previously gone into hiding at a United Nations building in Zambia's capital.

items.title: Russia says it helped to repel Niger attempted coup
items.description: Soldiers tried to attack a key military base early on Saturday morning, authorities say, but were thwarted.

items.title: British woman killed in stabbing at German railway station
items.description: A 27-year-old German man was arrested immediately after the incident in Rosenheim, Bavaria.

items.title: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
items.description: An investigation has begun into the storage of weapons for Ukraine's military near a residential area.

items.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos deported from US to UK
items.description: The self-styled provocateur had been detained by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).

items.title: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech
items.description: Haakon VIII pays emotional tribute to his late father, Harald V, before outlining how he wishes to reign.
